simple.meaning: מוֹדַע (môwdaʻ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “an acquaintance.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 2 times across Ruth, Proverbs, beginning at Ruth 2:1. Its contexts include family.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מוֹדַע (H4129).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
